instruction.text: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: It is safe to put your fingers in a plug socket.
It is not safe to overload plug sockets.
It is safe to use damaged wires.

atoms.b: There are ((++some no)) safety precautions that need to be considered when charging electronic devices.
Using a legitimate brand of charger can ((++decrease increase)) the risk of an electrical fire.
Charging a phone or a tablet under a pillow, blanket or duvet is ((++unsafe safe)) as it can cause an electrical fire.

instruction.text: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: It is safe to use a metal fork to get toast out of the toaster.

feedback.end: Metal conducts electricity, which can be dangerous. You should never put anything metal near an electrical output or appliance.

atoms.b: When removing a plug from a socket, you should only touch the ((++plastic metal)) part of it.
It is important to ((++never always)) touch the metal prongs on a plug when plugging something in.
